[Sir](../others.html#135)
I enclose £1.1 for the use of the poem on the Fireside.[^1] I believe [Mr Ward](../others.html#236) thought he had enclosed your note, and forgot to do so, and therefore I could not but be mortified at the refusal

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: ‘Pictures in the Fire’ by Adelaide Procter (1825-1864), whose hugely popular poetry was published by Bell.

The cheque for a guinea to G.

Bell was debited on 16 April. CMY was including the poem in an anthology published by Ward: [Aunt Charlotte\'s Evenings at Home with the Poets](../books.html#143) (1881).
